_comment: DRAFT — machine-translated into Russian (Русский) from en.json, NOT yet reviewed by a fluent speaker. Do not ship to users until a native speaker has proofread it, with particular attention to money (wallet, withdrawal, transfer, floorPrice), legal (deleteAccount, legal, register) and safety (shield, shieldActivateSheet, shieldBeneficiaries) sections. Russian uses four plural forms (one, few, many, other), so plural keys carry all four suffixes. Adding a new language: copy this file's key structure exactly, translate every value, then add an entry to SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES in i18n/index.js.
